batting.name: AM Rahane
batting.dismissal: c RR Rossouw b Harpreet Brar

batting.name: Sameer Rizvi
batting.dismissal: c HV Patel b K Rabada

batting.name: P Simran Singh
batting.dismissal: c RD Gaikwad b RJ Gleeson

batting.name: JM Bairstow
batting.dismissal: c MS Dhoni b S Dube

balls.text: Dhoni's streak of unbeaten innings end at 7 as he is run out trying to pinch a second run. Mistimes a shot just over short third man, and he gives it a chase to the boundary line before releasing a flat throw over the stumps at the keeper's end. Dhoni is short by a couple of inches and CSK finish on 162 for 7

low full toss outside off. Dhoni takes a big step on the off side and then launches a six high and mighty over cover! Bent his knees to ensure he put himself in the best position to get under the ball
short ball on middle. Dhoni too slow to get in position for the pull. Through to Jitesh as MSD misses the swing

low full toss around off. Dhoni toe-ends a sliced shot high up. But it lands safe before long off can run in. Mitchell runs across for a single but sees Dhoni hasn't run, so he completes that single, then turns around, and returns to the other end. Effectively runs two but with Dhoni not interested to get off strike, the CSK tally will say zero
another overpitched ball wide outside off and Dhoni reaches out to meet it for a cut. He misses as the ball lands beyond the crease but this time the umpire calls it a wide
another full toss angling across off stump. Dhoni tries to cream a shot through the covers but only finds air. On the bounce to Jitesh
Dhoni is on 7* with this boundary. Low full toss outside off and Dhoni absolutely splatters Arshdeep's delivery through the off side, creaming it past cover's right and long off's left.
very full and very wide. Landing beyond the pitch.  Wide given by the umpire
half-tracker outside off. Dhoni pumps a pull very hard but to the fielder at cow corner. Only three off the over and Rahul Chahar finishes with 2/16

Chahar now changes the angle of his run-up. Starts off running in from around the stumps, then snakes in front of the umpire before delivering a ball from over the stumps. Mitchell punches it through to the deep on the off side for a single

leg stump pegged back! Chahar silences the crowd again. Full ball on middle and leg but without much air. Moeen clears the front leg and tries to swing a shot across the line, but he's nowhere near the pitch of the ball. Chahar gets it to turn in and the poles light up
length ball on off stump and the skiddy delivery is bunted to the off side for one
length ball on leg stump. Dhoni moves to the off side to play a paddle to fine leg. But he misses and Jitesh moves across to stop some byes. Interestingly wide not given
Chahar to bowl the 19th. Dhoni against spin. A length ball around off stump. Cut to cover point
muscles the first ball through the off side for a single. There's a sweeper fielder in the deep

onto his stumps! Yorker just outside leg, and Gaikwad skips further outside leg stump to extract more room. The ball tails across the right-hander and into the stumps as Gaikwad tries to go inside out. However, it kisses the face of the bat before crashing into leg stump.

slower ball bouncer very wide outside leg stump. The length ends up being right because Gaikwad also backs away and ends up below the ball. However the height is a problem, so Arshdeep collects another wide
full ball outside off. Moeen breaks his wrists while trying to play a shot through the off side, thereby sending the ball to deep backward point

full ball outside off and Moeen lets it go. Ball through to Jitesh, and the umpire gives it a wide, but was that inside the tram-lines? PBKS think so, and therefore they review. Replay shows the ball is just outside the guideline, so the wide-call remains
straight down the ground! Arshdeep misses the yorker by a few inches, and Moeen clears the front leg before drilling it back past the non-striker for four more. Long on had no chance on that occasion
yorker ball around off and Moeen can only dig it back to Arshdeep on this occasion

Bairstow clips it over! Slot ball just outside off. Moeen tries to get under it while muscling a shot down the V. Bairstow at long off sticks his hands up to take a catch, but the ball hits his palm and parries over
slower ball bouncer, but very wide outside off. Left alone by Moeen
the crowd is has found their voice again! Short ball on leg stump and Gaikwad thwacks a pull high into the night sky. Sits up well for him to climb into that. The ball finally comes down 15 rows back
full ball wider outside off. Gaikwad attempts a square drive with the bat's face open. Can't beat point
back of a length ball angling into Moeen. Swivels and pulls along the carpet to deep backward square leg
short ball gets big on Gaikwad and he mistimes a pull to long on
fifty for Gaikwad! First six of the game! Slot ball is perfect for Gaikwad, and he simply pumps it over wide long on for six. Deep in his crease and hammered into the stands

Curran bowls a loose wide ball that is also a high full toss, and Gaikwad slaps behind square over the infield for four. The umpires call it a no-ball for height but Curran reviews. Technology says ball height is 1.08m , Gaikwad's waist is measured at 1m, so it is a no-ball. Free hit coming up
full ball on middle, and clipped to midwicket's left for a single
length ball on leg stump and he pushes a shot towards mid-on's left for a single. Rabada finishes with 1/23
bangs it in short but it doesn't bounce a lot. Late glance to deep third by Gaikwad
length ball angling across and slapped to the off side for one
back of a length ball just outside leg. Moeen gets inside the line of the ball to play a shot on the leg side. Misses, and the umpire calls it a wide

Harshal slides and completes the catch! Rabada with a length ball around off stump and Rizvi tries to play an upper cut over third man but Rizvi doesn't add any pace to it with his bat, and he ends up offering catching practice to Harshal running in from deep third. A laboured innings comes to an end
back of a length ball outside off. Rizvi sticks the bat out to play a late shot to third man, but it takes a bottom edge, and gets the ball just past a diving Jitesh with the gloves
good length ball on middle, and he mistimes a pull in front of square for a single
bunted towards cover for a single as we get done with the fifteenth. CSK pick up 12 runs this over
good length ball outside off and tapped to the vacant area near point for two more to the total. Team 100 in 14.5 overs
back of a length, quite wide outside off. Rizvi tries to slap this away but mistimes this 122kph delivery. They scurry across for one
full ball on leg stump. Worked off his toes to deep backward square for one
full ball just outside off. Rizvi attempts a big shot but can't get underneath the ball completely. Mistimed to long on for just a single
gets the line right, but bowls in the slot outside off. Crunches a drive, but Curran intercepts standing on the circle
starts off with five wides! So CSK get a boundary, but not off the bat. Wild delivery, full and very wide, going over the tram-lines on the leg side to the fine-leg fence
play and miss. Fullish ball outside off and Rizvi tried to slog across the line but took his eyes off the ball. Through to Jitesh with the ball also staying a shade low
yorker attempted, decent execution. Around leg stump and Rizvi brings the bat down in anticipation. Digs it out
good length ball on middle. Gaikwad makes room but can only guide the shot to short third
another pull attempted, another mistimed shot to the leg side. Rizvi is trying to mow these length balls over the leg side but it is coming off the top-half of the bat everytime
length ball on off and Rizvi mistimes an attempted pull. Wasn't really the height to pull anyway, and he ended up shoveling a shot high up. But had enough to clear the midwicket fielder
length ball on middle, and clipped to deep backward square leg. Quick work from Shashank there, with the pick up and release
full ball just outside off. Tapped to point for a single, and it will remain a single despite Chahar's misfield. Brar finishes with 2/17 as we take another time out.
lands safe at cow corner. Rizvi tries to pull over deep midwicket but it comes high off the bat. A good length ball angling into him
full ball on middle and he closes the bat's face in his defensive shot, sending the ball to square leg for a single
full ball on middle and leg. Rizvi gets low and plays an extravagant sweep, but only a single to fine leg
length ball around off stump. Punched to the off side but can't find the gap
length ball angling into the right-hander. Tries to flick it behind square but misses and it hits his body outside leg stump
tossed up on off stump. Flicked off his toes to wide long on. Again only five off the over

run out appeal! Chahar with a googly from a good length, and the batter uses his wrists to clip it towards wide long on. Rizvi is slow on the turn for the second run and has to dive in with the throw going to his end. Jitesh clips the bails off but replays show that Rizvi's dive saved him
back of a length on middle. Played square to deep midwicket after getting onto the back foot
full ball just outside off. Turning away and driven to cover
length ball just outside off. Bit of turn away. Rizvi attempts a late cut but he misses and is lucky that did not kiss the bat en route to Jitesh
half-tracker around off. Rizvi goes onto the back foot and plays a swipe across the line. But straight to midwicket
full ball on off. Big stride in before driving to long off. Just five off the over and CSK are 76/3 in 11 overs
full ball around off. Bit of turn away. Rizvi checks a shot towards short cover once again
full ball outside off. Checked drive to the off side

length ball around off. Driven with the turn to cover on the up, where Curran drives forward to parry the ball towards the point fielder. The  man has a shy at the stumps, but it doesn't hit the stumps and also costs an over-throw
length ball just outside off. Tries to punch through the off side but the turn induces a thick outside edge. Chahar, at short third, dives to stop this mis-hit
full ball around off. Bit of turn away. Driven to cover
full ball with some air. Lands around off stump. Guided off the back foot to square leg, and Jitesh gives the ball a chase with the gloves

Chahar is interested, and the umpire gives it out! Jadeja turns to walk back but then Gaikwad runs across to have a chat. Sends it up for a review. This was a full ball on off stump that turned in sharply and hit Jadeja on the front leg. The bat is nowhere near the ball, so the TV umpire moves directly to ball-tracking. Has it turned too much? No, crashing into leg stump. CSK lose their second review and third wicket. Jadeja beaten by the degree of turn
good length ball on middle stump. Worked to the leg side for a single
half-tracker with some width on offer too! Rocks back and cuts it to deep point
another length ball around leg and turning into middle. Gaikwad bunts a back-foot swipe to long on
length ball outside leg and turning into middle. Gaikwad swivels to play across the line but he's surprised by the bounce. Hits him on the body
good length ball on middle. Jadeja hangs back and works it off his body to the leg side
full ball on middle stump. Pushed to long on for a single
full ball outside off. Jadeja toe-ends a shovel to mid on for one

big lbw appeal, and given! Oh what a moment in this game. Dube reviews. This was a full ball on middle stump, slowed down by Brar, and Dube gets low for a big heave across the line. The ball goes under the bat and hits him on the back leg. Verdict: crashing into middle stump!
full ball outside leg. Turning down leg further. Wide given

Brar gets the breakthrough! Tosses up a full ball on middle. Rahane gets low and tries to play a slog sweep, but he gets a big top-edge as he plays against the turn. Cow corner calls for it and then completes the rest. Breakthrough for PBKS!
length ball on off. Punched towards cover, where Curran stops
tossed up but Rahane can't get under it well. Toe-ends a drive with the turn to long off
skiddier delivery, length ball on middle and sliding towards leg. Rahane also backs away to make room but Chahar's delivery follows him. Cramped, but cut to cover point
slows it down a bit. Fullish ball on middle. Turning towards off. Gaikwad goes back and then plays a punchy shot towards midwicket
full ball just outside off. Drilled past Chahar and the umpire for a single to long on
full ball around off. Bit of turn away. Gaikwad backs away and cuts it well to the deep
full ball outside off. Turning away. Mistimed cut to point
full ball outside off. Comes down the track but settles for a drive down to long off. Tidy over from Brar as we take a time out
full ball on middle. Rahane goes deep in his crease and opts to flick it off the back foot to fine leg
good length ball just outside off. Tapped to the acres of space on the off side for a single
full ball on middle and he drives to long on for a walking single
full ball on middle. Tries to clip it behind square as the ball angles into him. But misses, and it hits hispad
good length ball just outside off. Bunted to the off side for a single

the crowd is loving it! Length ball around off and angling away. Curran tries to end the powerplay with a slower ball but Rahane pounces onto the lack of pace to clobber a slap behind point. CSK 55/0 in the powerplay
like a....tracer bullet! Curran pitches it up around off on pace. Rahane shuffles forward in one fluid motion, and then meets it under his eyeline. Through the covers
this time it is off the bat! Short of good-length ball on middle. Rahane gets in position very quickly for a pull, and then smacks it high into the night sky in front of square
more runs! Leg-byes the signal from the umpire. Curran with a length ball outside leg and Rahane attempts a flick fine down the leg side
good length ball on middle stump. Nurdled off his body to midwicket
short of good length on middle and leg stump. Worked off his body to deep square leg for a single

placed in the gap! There was a second slip and a short third present, but Gaikwad gets it between them with a late cut. This was another Arshdeep slowie, and Gaikwad had not picked it up, but he escapes

change of angle, comes around the wicket, and appeals for lbw right away! Gaikwad tries to clip this full ball through the leg side but misses, however he is safe from the lbw since the ball was swinging in too much
picks the slower ball beautifully! Arshdeep rolls his fingers over this delivery, and Gaikwad waits for the ball to come to him before slapping a cut behind point, along the ground, for four.
another length ball around off but this time the cut gets a bottom-edge towards short third for a single
slashed over backward point! Just a bit of width with Arshdeep trying to bowl a length ball across Rahane, but this time he commits to the aggressive shot and hits it rather well!
length ball on off and angling away. Knocked off the back foot to point for a quick single
length ball angling away. Rahane throws his bat at this, trying to clear the infield over the off side. But he only finds air. Through to Jitesh and Curran concedes only three in his opening over
fullish ball on off and middle. Driven down the track, but Curran gets low to stop it
full ball bit wider outside off. Reaches out and drives to deep extra cover for a single
good length ball just outside leg. Tucks it off his body with the bat's closed face to deep midwidwicket for a couple. Gaikwad had to adjust and play it late because Curran delivered the slower ball
fullish ball around off. Gaikwad fends tentatively, trying to keep an eye on the ball
this is a fullish ball. Wobbly seam. Ball holds its line instead of swinging in. Gaikwad looks to drive down the V but the ball whizzes past the outside edge
first four off Rahane's bat! Full ball outside off, Rahane attempts the drive but the bat's face turns and that's enough to send the ball between short third and deep point for four!
full ball on his toes and he swivels and then clips it off his heel to fine leg for a single
length ball just outside off. Poked to short third and turns down the single
good length ball outside off. Rising delivery and Rahane tries to follow the delivery with the bat. Misses, through to the keeper
length ball angling into him. Tries to flick it off his waist to fine leg but is beaten by the pace. Ball hits his thigh pad and rolls away
full ball just outside off and a compact front-foot drive from Rahane. But stopped at cover

that's ten off the over as Gaikwad delicately plays a ramp over slip! Good length ball around off and Gaikwad bends his knees and sticks his bat out in such a way that he can lift it over the keeper and first slip. It's what we call the uparcut in gully cricket
good length ball angling across. Guides it down to deep backward point, using the left-arm seamer's angle from over the stumps
searches for the swing with a fuller ball around off. Gaikwad drives to cover's right, but the fielder gets a palm to it
first boundary of the evening and it is a classical punch off the back foot, and through the small gap between cover point and point. Backed his timing and hands, didn't try to muscle the shot
good length ball outside off. But this one bounces extra and Gaikwad misses the attempted poke away from his body. Jitesh takes from head height
length ball around off and angling across. He tries to play a punch through the covers but misses
good length ball outside off. Hangs back and keeps the bat's face open. Ball hits the face of the bat and races away to deep point
full ball just outside off. Steady shuffle forward onto a the front foot for a drive. But caressed straight to the cover fielder
short of good length ball. Normal bounce onto Rahane. Knocked off the back foot to the off side for one
good length ball outside off. Taps this towards backward point after riding the bounce
off the mark but not comfortably. Back of a length ball outside off but jags in with solid bounce. Rahane tiptoes to fend but it hits the edge of the blade and squirts away to the leg side
welcomed with a short ball. Spongy bounce en route to Rahane, who takes his eyes off the ball and gets hit on the glove near his face

Is that it? Yes, via an overthrow. Short of a length ball on middle and leg, worked to deep square leg. A wild throw comes in and Punjab Kings have defeated CSK by seven wickets at 13 balls remaining.
Fuller on leg stump, he looks to flick it away again and misses again and is struck on the pad for a leg-bye

Huge appeal for lbw. Did that pitch in line?  Curran has reviewed. Was a full-length ball on middle and leg. Curran gets across, misses and is struck right in front of middle and leg. No bat. But where's the impact? The ball is pitching outside leg. The umpire has to change his decision.
Doesn't get hold of it but Dube has made a mess of it at deep midwicket. Length on off stump, he heaves it across the line. Dube gets across, and over-runs it. Done by the spin
Misses out. Length ball right across Curran, who targets going across the line and makes no connection
Ooh, he's lost the radar completely. The ball slipped out of his hands there and went way above the waist outside off.
Slower ball well outside off, he drags it to deep midwicket
Another wide? Yep. Slower offcutter well outside the tramline. Curran almost swung himself off his feet attempting the shot
Swung away and he gets two, even though he mistimes it completely. Length ball on middle and leg, he gets it off the cue end of the blade to deep midwicket
Slower bouncer and this was definitely high outside off. Called a wide straight away.
Banged in short, he is rushed into the pull and misses. Punjab review this time asking for a wide on height. That looks high, tbh. And yep, the wide has been signaled. PBKS' 150 comes up
Just short of Mitchell at long-off and they don't run. They don't want to improve their NRR? Back of a length ball outside off, he cracks it towards the fielder

Huge swing and a miss. Was a slower offcutter outside off, he attempts a wild hack, but does not connect. Called wide but Dhoni is not convinced. Gaikwad reviews. But the ball is past the tramline. CSK out of reviews
Length ball on pace across Shashank who finally lays a bat on it and times it to deep point
Fizz is all over Shashank today. Slower offcutter angling across Shashank who throws his bat at it, but misses
Length on middle and leg, he pushes to long-on
Fuller on leg stump, he whisks it to deep midwicket
Good length ball outside off, he pushes to long on
Looks to go again, but cannot get under the ball this time. Was a touch flatter outside off, he drags it to the right of deep midwicket
He finally gets hold of one, and won't he be relieved. Was a stifle short outside off, he gets back and across and pounds him over deep midwicket
Length on off stump, he works it with soft hands to long-on.
A hint of turn with that dry ball. Was on a length outside off, he pushes back to the bowler
Maiden over! That is stunning work by Fizz. Banged in short outside off, Shashank looks to ramp this over the keeper's head, but makes no connection
Slower offcutter outside off, he pushes to extra cover. No runs off this over so far.
Good length ball just outside off, he plays with soft hands with an open face of the bat but can't beat point
Slower offcutter angling right across Shashank who has a swipe at it, but misses
On a length angling across Shashank who punches straight to extra cover.
Nearly chops it on. Length ball angling across Shashank, who gets a thick inside edge that could have easily gone back on to his stumps
Sycthed away over point. Was a pacy back of a length ball outside off. He throws his bat at it and hammers it over the fielder's head
That's really well done by Curran. Fuller outside off, he just open the face of the bat and guides it past the keeper. Shardul has over-stepped well. Not going to plan today for CSK.
On a length on middle, he clips it to Gaikwad at long-on
Banged in short, he pulls to deep backward square leg

Dropped by Mitchell running back. Should he have left it for long-on? Cross-seam length ball on middle. Shashank looks to go down-town, gets more elevation than distance. Mitchell runs back from mid-on, gets both hands to it but spills the catch
Ooh, what a ball! Length ball nibbling away from the batter, who looks to drive on the move. Is lucky to not get an edge on that
Pacy back of a length ball around his chest. He pulls to deep square leg
Full outside off, he digs it out to long off
On a length on middle and leg, he clips it to the left of deep midwicket. Shouts of two again, they get two again
Two, two, two is the call from Curran and gets them easy. Low full toss on middle and leg, he clips it over midwicket. Lots of empty spaces there.
Length ball at 140.1kph on middle stump, he gets across and whips it to deep square leg
Banged in short on leg stump, he gets inside the line and pulls it down to deep fine leg
Back of a length ball outside off, he plays with an open face to deep third
Length down leg, called a wide

Misses out on a full toss and Rossouw is a goner! Cross-seam outside off, was there to be smacked away but Rossouw  looks to muscle it away. Loses his shape as he goes across the line, gets a thick inside-edge on to his back leg and on to the stumps.
Full again on off stump, he gets across and digs it to long-on
Fuller and driven elegantly. Just timing, nothing else. Was in the slot for Shashank who presented the full face of the bat and drove to the right of mid-off
Slower offcutter outside off, he slaps it to deep cover
Slower bouncer well outside off, that was too high though
UP AND OVER! That was a gift from Shardul and Rossouw accepts it with glee. Was short and wide, he stands tall and cuts it over deep point
Fuller in length on off stump, he shimmies down the track looking to go over the off side. Instead drags it to long on
Short and wide, he cuts it hard to deep point
Another quick length ball on off stump, defended to cover
Darted on middle stump, he backs away giving himself room and thrashes it to extra cover
Flatter at 90.7kph on middle stump, he defends back to the bowler
Fuller down leg, he works it to deep backward square leg
Flatter length ball outside off, he pushes to long-off
Another offcutter but he got the room and latched onto it in a flash. 113kph length ball outside off. He slams it past extra cover and into the fence the ball goes
Two, two, two is the call and he gets it. Slower offcutter at 114.1kph outside off. Was on a length as he punches it to the right of long-off
Pulled handsomely! Banged in short on Rossouw's hips on middle, he gets inside the line and helps him deep over square leg
Walks down the track first ball. It was a length delivery outside off, he opens the face of his blade and guides to deep third

Edged and Dube has a wicket second ball of the season. Was a nonchalant short of a length ball just on off. Was a cutter at 122.6kph. He opens the face of the bat, looking for a ramp. Instead gets a thick edge straight to Dhoni. Jonny B falls for a 30-ball 46
Banged in short first up outside off, he pulls to deep midwicket
Another ball that is short and wide, he stays back and cuts to the left of Rizvi who gets across in time for a couple of runs
Low full toss on middle, he mistimes to extra cover
Short, wide and hammered away.  Enough room outside off, he rocks back and slaps it really hard. Rizvi sprints across from deep cover and puts in a full-length dive, but can't keep it in
Flatter just on off stump, he stays leg side of the ball and bunts to the left of short third
Pushed at 93.7kph on off stump, he pushes towards cover point and sets off
Fuller on leg stump, he works it to deep square leg with soft hands but have to content with a single

Jadeja goes for the the catch, misses the ball and Bairstow gets another four. Floated just outside off, he sweeps it hard and flat to deep midwicket who hares forward eyeing the catch. Does not get it and what's worse, the ball eludes him too
Short and punished! On off stump, he hops back and powerfully pulls him over wide long-on
Tossed up outside off, he lines up for the sweep, but misses and is hit in the midriff. The impact was outside off
Keeps it on a length on middle and leg, he turns it to deep midwicket
Tossed up on middle, he defends back to the bowler
Fuller on off, he pushes to extra cover
PUMMELED! Dragged down on off, he goes back and smashes the pull to the right of deep midwicket. The fielder gets a hand on it but can't rein it in
Gives himself room again and thrashes the length ball outside off to extra cover. A slight misfield but no harm done
Cuts it right off his stumps, and gets four for his effort. That was bowled at 101.8kph on off and middle. Bairstow stays leg side of the ball and late cuts it past short third
Darted in at 95.2kph on off, he scythes it to short cover
Slower length ball on the pads, he ticks it to short fine leg for another quick single
Flatter just outside off, he cuts to short third and sets off

Just short of Fizz at short fine leg. Length ball on his hips, Bairstow looks to help it away over short fine, but the ball hits the splice of his bat and goes to Fizz. A direct hit at the striker's end but Rossouw was in
Another back of a length ball, on pace this time. He pulls it to deep square leg
Belted! Slower-offcutter but that was dragged down a touch. He backs away, left leg to the leg side and clubs it to the right of mid-on
Off-pace length ball slanting across the batter, who cuts to deep point
Length ball on middle stump, he gets that left foot of his out of the way again, and slaps it hard. Can't beat mid-off though
THRASHED! Back of a length ball on off stump, Bairstow steps to the leg side and smashes him through covers
Short and wide well outside off. He stands tall and cuts it up and over point. A couple of bounces and into the fence
Very slow, dipping full ball but the line is down leg. Called a wide
Slammed! On the fuller side just outside off. He takes a couple of strides across to the off side and whips it over midwicket. Was the slower offcutter picked well by Rossouw
Length ball slanting into the batter, who can't do much about it. Defends back towards the bowler
On a length on middle stump, Rossouw works it to midwicket
Fuller in length outside off, he times it sweetly on the up to the right of Gaikwad at mid-off, who does well diving to his right
Fuller and well outside off, he reaches for it and can only mistime his drive to cover
Back of a length ball just outside off, he gets on top of the bounce and cuts to deep point
Fuller outside off, he looks to force a drive through covers, instead gets it off the inside half of the bat to mid-on
Length ball angling across Rossouw who defends towards cover point
Two in two. Short of a length ball on his hips, he swivels and helps it to the right of deep backward square leg
What a way to start the innings. Too full on middle, Rossouw stays leg side of the ball, presents the full face of the bat and gets it racing to the left of mid-on

Gleeson has his first wicket of the season and this is well deserved! The length ball on middle does the job. A hint of nibble away from the batter and that was enough. Prabhsimran looks to turn it to the leg side but is caught in a tangle. He gets a leading edge and Gaikwad moving to his left from mid-off ain't dropping those.

Huge appeal for lbw as Prabhsimran goes for the scoop, misses and is rapped on the pad. Prolonged appeal but the umpire is unmoved. Gaikwad asks for a review. Oh, replays confirm that there is a huge deflection onto his pads. He absolutely smashed it. CSK lose a review early.
Lovely bowling, this. A play and a miss again. Fizz goes on-pace angling the ball across Prabh, who feels for the ball outside off. Lucky to not get an edge on it
Back of a length ball on middle, he stands tall and defends back to the bowler
Chance of a run out but Rizvi misses. Good length ball slanting back on middle stump. He stays leg side of the ball and pushes to point. Think Prabhsimran was struggling with a direct hit
On the bounce to mid-on. Fuller in length on middle and leg. He punches it aerially but not enough power to go to hand
Length ball nibbling back into Prabhsimran on leg stump. He pushes towards mid-on for a quick run
Finally gets hold of one and Bairstow is off the mark, finally. Fuller in length outside off, he drives aerially but to the left of Gaikwad. The ball races away on this Chepauk turf
Full on the stumps, he digs it to mid-on

And again! This time the outswinger. What a start from Gleeson. Bairstow has no idea which direction the ball is moving. On a length just outside off and continues to move away. Bairstow looks to go up and over, can't get anywhere near it
Sliding down leg? Probably. This one shapes back sharply into Bairstow. Was a length ball tailing into the batter, who looks to go big, misses and is rapped on the pads
Another play and a miss. He goes a touch full and outside off. There was a little bit of nibble away as well. Jonny B was lining it by going leg side of the ball. But he gets beaten by that swing
Pacy back of a length ball outside off stump. Bairstow looks to thrash it away, but misses
Length ball on middle and leg, he gets across and tucks it to deep backward square leg with soft hands
Back of a length ball tailing away well outside off stump. Prabhsimran dabs it to deep third
Back of a length ball outside off, he stands tall and defends towards covers
And he's welcomed with a ravishing pull. That is a shot of some authority from Prabhsimran. Banged in short and into his body. He swivels and pulls over the deep square leg fence
UP and OVER! Short, wide and well outside off. He frees his arms and thrashes him over covers to get going in style
Hint of shape away from the batter. Was a back of a length ball outside off. He feels for it and is beaten
